verdict.rationale: The only evidence of a first-party bulk capability is the CLI's ability to manage "batches" alongside calls. That implies batch-call operations across many items, but the evidence never describes what a batch does or how bulk actions apply across items. Outreach workflows and the "thousands of calls" marketing claim do not show bulk operations themselves. Missing for 10: documented batch API/semantics (e.g. bulk call upload or scheduling), bulk operations on other item types (agents, numbers, executions), limits and error handling for bulk runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
